# Pro Skill Packs

> Tested skills for the jobs you do every week. Plain-text SKILL.md skills (the open Agent Skills format) that work with any assistant that reads them (Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and others), plus a paste-in prompt version for ChatGPT or any chatbot. Free skills are on GitHub (MIT); paid skills and packs are sold on Gumroad.

## Site structure
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/ : the catalog (search, category chips, price and type filters)
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/for/<category>/ : one page per category with its skills, prompts and guides
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/<skill>/ and https://proskillpacks.github.io/packs/<pack>/ : one page per skill or pack, with a real before and after, limits and install steps
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/free/ : every free skill, installable with `npx skills add proskillpacks/skills`
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/prompts/ : free paste-in prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any chatbot
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/guides/ : how-to guides, grouped by category, including install guides for each tool
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/study/ : data studies with data files
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/new/ and https://proskillpacks.github.io/feed.xml : what is new
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/faq/, https://proskillpacks.github.io/about/ : questions, licence, refunds, contact
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/catalog/catalog.json : the whole catalog as JSON

## Shopify store owners
- [Quick check: can AI shopping assistants read your store?](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/agent-ready-quick-check/) (Free): Your store address in, six checks set against 99 other stores.
- [See how AI shopping assistants read your store](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/agent-ready-store-audit/) ($5): Your store address in, a score out of 100 and the top 7 fixes.
- [Plan your Black Friday sale on your own prices](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/bfcm-campaign-kit/) ($5): Your store address in, offer maths, a calendar, emails and texts.
- [Gather the evidence for a chargeback](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/chargeback-evidence-checklist/) (Free): The dispute reason in, the evidence to collect and where to find it.
- [Answer a chargeback: the right letter for each reason](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/chargeback-response-writer/) ($5): The dispute reason and your evidence in, the right letter back.
- [Rewrite thin product descriptions without made-up claims](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/product-description-rewriter/) ($5): Your store or a product in, descriptions ready to paste into Shopify.
- [Clean up messy product titles](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/product-title-cleaner/) (Free): Your store in, one tidy title style as an import file.
- [Reply to reviews without promising what you can't give](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/review-reply-drafter/) (Free): Your reviews in, a reply for each, risky ones flagged.
- [Write image descriptions (alt text) for your products](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/shopify-alt-text-writer/) (Free): Your store in, alt text for every product photo as an import file.
- [Check your store policies for gaps and mixed messages](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/shopify-policy-checker/) (Free): Your store address in, gaps in your policies and wording to paste.
- [Handle the weekly jobs in a Shopify store: six workflows](https://proskillpacks.github.io/packs/store-ops-pack/) ($29): Your store address in, six tools built from your own store data.

## Freelancers and consultants
- [Win a client job, from brief to scope](https://proskillpacks.github.io/packs/client-winning-pack/) ($19): A client brief in, a proposal, a compliance check, a scope of work and a call brief out. Tested on real public tenders.
- [Prepare for a first call from the prospect's website](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/discovery-call-brief/) ($5): A prospect's website in, a one-page brief and questions to ask.
- [Chase a late invoice (UK), with the interest worked out](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/late-payment-chaser-uk/) (Free): An invoice date and amount in, the interest you can claim and reminder emails.
- [Write a scope of work before you start](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/scope-of-work-builder/) ($5): A client brief in, deliverables, milestones and a payment schedule.

## Studies
- [How portable are the most-installed agent skills?](https://proskillpacks.github.io/study/portability/): We scanned the most-installed agent skills on skills.sh for ties to one assistant: tool names, paths, frontmatter keys and scripts. Data and scripts included.
- [What the most-installed agent skills actually do](https://proskillpacks.github.io/study/top-skills/): We sorted the top 100 skills on skills.sh by the job they do and by publisher, with the keyword rules published. Data and scripts included.
- [We re-tested 69 skills on harder inputs. 16 failed. Here is what broke.](https://proskillpacks.github.io/study/retest/): We gave 69 skills a second run on a deliberately hard input. 16 had a defect, mostly unsure input restated as fact. What broke, what we changed, and the limits.
- [State of Agent-Ready Shopify](https://proskillpacks.github.io/study/shopify-agent-ready/)
